about_the_game:
■ Store Description

One booster. Three rookies. Who gets the power?

  • Mutants have overrun the cyberpunk megacity. Three rookie cyborgs face a deadly choice with only a single Omega Booster between them.

"Only 1 of 3 can become superhuman!"

ZENITH precision, VULCAN firepower, RUSTY defense. Which philosophy will save the team? Real-time tactical co-op rogue-lite action where you share power on the fly—your judgment determines everything.

■ Detailed Description

《OMEGA PROTOCOL》is a 3-player cooperative rogue-lite action game.

  • Government collapsed megacity. Mutants born from biochemical disasters have seized control of the city. You're deployed as a rookie cyborg team from a private security corporation, but you've made a fatal mistake—bringing only one Omega Booster.

Core Features:

  • Real-time Booster Switching: Decide who gets enhanced each moment. Cooperation clashes with survival instinct.

  • Brand Philosophy System: ZENITH precision, VULCAN firepower, RUSTY defense—each ideology dominates combat differently.

  • Rogue-lite Dungeons: Every run brings new stages and unpredictable enemies.

  • Strategic Cooperation: Perfect teamwork is the answer. But sometimes perfect selfishness is also the answer.

One choice creates heroes, another demands sacrifice. Who lives, and who becomes powerful?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (Version 1903)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 25 GB available space

short_description: "Choose, boost, survive!" Rogue-lite Co-op Action!! 3 rookies vs mutants with ONE shared power-up. Survive together by passing boost between teammates! Sniper needs precision? Give it! Tank under attack? Switch instantly! Steal power from allies or sacrifice yourself. Teamwork meets betrayal.
